name: Amondi Kibaki
source:
A Special Warfare Trooper from Ethiopia and G09's First Lieutenant. Just like [url=/c102746]Minori[/url], she came to the Cathedral after graduating from the officers' academy.

Despite appearing quite aloof, Kibaki is a very proactive girl who, deep down, is quite fierce. 

She enjoys smoking. Just like [url=/c105887]Alisha[/url], she used to live in a refugee camp.

 [Translated from [url=https://metalogiq.jp/games/deadendaegis_fd/chara_01amondi.html]official website[/url]]
